question: In Proverbs 30:8-9, why does Agur ask God for neither poverty nor riches?
options: So he will not disown God or dishonor His name
So he can become a king
So he can give more to the temple
explanation: Agur prays for only his daily bread, fearing that riches might make him disown God, and poverty might lead him to steal and dishonor God's name.
